title: Before Explanation · Why read this book?

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: What happens before an explanation starts governing reality?

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: This book examines how explanations shape understanding, responsibility, and power in everyday life.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: It follows the distance between persuasive stories and the realities they claim to describe.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Its chapters connect cognitive psychology, institutional decisions, personal relationships, and artificial intelligence.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Readers encounter questions about evidence, uncertainty, competing interpretations, and the boundaries of useful models.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The final part introduces outfinitism as a proposed research programme concerned with limits of knowledge.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The discussion addresses readers interested in reasoning, organizational judgment, and the ethical stakes of making sense of experience.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: This invitation is for readers interested in reasoning, institutions, psychology, and artificial intelligence.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Read Before Explanation to follow the complete argument, examples, and consequences.
